text.card: A red giant 2,153 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.42 solar masses and 9.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,794 K at its surface.
